title: Complete the matrix-Jensen candidate proof
objective: Give a line-by-line proof or a concrete counterexample for C010, including the exact expected triangular-factor identity, energy identity, Jensen step and asymptotic consequence.
acceptance_checks: All multiplication orders and permutation conventions are explicit.
Operator-convex Jensen direction and definiteness hypotheses are justified.
The fixed-initial-point and spectral-radius consequences are distinguished.
The proof lists what it does and does not imply about C001.
